responsibility: This machine description provides the DFA scheduler model for the M5100 core. It defines separate ALU, MDU, and FPU resources and target-specific reservations for integer, branch, load/store, multiply/divide, HI/LO, and floating-point arithmetic, conversion, transfer, and reciprocal-square-root operations, giving GCC the timing model needed to tune for MIPS32r5 m5100-class processors.
